title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 225
text:
83. Judges need to be aware if mental health is an issue, both so that all reasonable
adjustments can be made, and to make the most appropriate disposal decision. Either
because of the stigma attached or because of lack of self-awareness, many defendants will
not have informed the criminal justice system that they have a mental disability.162

84. The increased use of video hearings makes it harder for courts to identify whether a
defendant has a cognitive impairment, mental ill health or a neurodiverse condition.163

162 “Inclusive justice: a system designed for all. Findings and recommendations”: EHRC (June 2020).

163 “Inclusive justice: a system designed for all. Interim evidence report. Video hearings and their impact on effective
participation”: EHRC (22 April 2020).
Mental disability
